$comment: Machine-readable conflict policy for upstream sync. Read by scripts/sync-upstream.sh and scripts/sync-upstream.ps1 so the two cannot drift apart. Human-readable explanation lives in UPSTREAM_SYNC.md.

oursRationale.mosaic-brand/*: source artwork; upstream has no equivalent
oursRationale.packages/excalidraw/locales/en.json: contains the rebranded product name; the other 57 locales are Crowdin-managed and must take upstream
oursRationale.mosaic-dashboard/**: Mosaic-only dashboard app; upstream has no counterpart, so this only matters if a future upstream adds a colliding path

theirsRationale: Everything else is upstream-maintained code. Taking our side of an unrelated conflict would freeze us on stale code and drop upstream's security fixes.
